limitations: Manifest excludes itself to avoid a circular checksum.
Original report pointers retain local artifact paths; manifest destinations identify public copies.
Any readiness/preflight usage is separate from task comparisons. Earlier draft/corpus validation is retained separately and is not formal A/B evidence.
Supplemental attempts never replace original rows or enter primary aggregates.
Untracked file contents in archives/worktrees and initialization fixture partials are excluded; tracked patches and untracked names remain.
B passes prepared context through a private temporary descriptor. preparation.json retains forwarding/source hashes and byte counts, not the private stdin body; prompt.txt is the common caller input.
Preparation source hashes attest frozen pre-execution delivery, not semantic completeness or later freshness. Intentional caller-context bypasses remain primary B observations.
Research access/fetch JSON logs preserve failed HTTP requests; arbitrary raw .source bodies, binaries and research caches are not selected.
Credential-pattern scanning and explicit paths are guards, not proof against every possible secret.

Only the two exact frozen Python XML files permit literal-verified synthetic credential patterns inside designated testcase names; original bytes are preserved and every other byte is scanned. Raw browser configuration remains private.
